findings.message: 1 large-set statement(s) run past 3 lines at 1440px: "I’m a developer who transforms ideas int…" → 5 lines at 36px
findings.fix: A statement set large is about 30 words. Cut it, or set the rest as ordinary body text.

findings.message: 2 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.
Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.
Prefer sentence case at body size.

findings.message: 2 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): hr.mt-4 1222px rule | hr.mt-4 1222px rule
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: Unreadable text: "Sleeksky Technologies, San Francisco (Re" 2.2:1 (#a9afb8 on #ffffff); "Penguin Apps, Mumbai (Remote)" 2.2:1 (#a9afb8 on #ffffff); "Maharashtra Institute of Technology, Aur" 2.2:1 (#a9afb8 on #ffffff); "creates" 2.5:1 (#9ca3af on #ffffff)
findings.fix: Raise contrast to at least 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for large display.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (6.4:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: The same large text stays on screen for 4 screens in a row: "About"; "Projects"
findings.fix: A pinned element earns two screens, and something must change at each. Shorten the run or give every screen its own content.

findings.message: 2 of 8 desktop screens are almost empty ground (under 20% of the screen holds text, a picture or a colour field): screens 4, 8.
findings.fix: An empty screen is a rest only once per page. Elsewhere it means the section is underbuilt: set its content larger, give it the full information, put it on a colour field, or cut it.
